guide: Hello! I'm the local guide for this trail.
It's a loop: reach the viewpoint on the ridge, then come back to the finish sign next to me.
Don't run too much, you'll tire fast. Rest on the benches if you need to.
Photograph flowers and animals, but never pick them. Please pick up any litter you see.
If you run out of water, refill at the forest stream. Have fun!

guide_khaosok: Hello, and welcome to the Khao Sok rainforest.
The main trail follows Khlong Sok to Ton Kloi Waterfall, passing Bang Hua Raet and Wing Hin falls.
The steep side path south across the stream leads to where the Rafflesia grows. Photograph it, but never touch it or step around it.
If you hear loud calls echoing through the forest in the morning, that's wildlife. Walk quietly and look up into the tall trees.
